Good morning. This is the briefing from yesterday's board meeting, for everyone who could not attend. The chief executive said that the southern plan had been approved, with one condition. The finance director warned that the budget would not be increased before the second quarter, so the first phase has to be delivered with the current team. Two directors argued that the timeline was too short, and the board noted their position in the minutes. Our commercial director confirmed that the new benchmark would be applied from March. Finally, the board asked whether the model could be extended to the fresh categories this year, and the answer we gave was that it could, but not before September.

Hi, it is Tom from the analytics team. I could not join the call, so here is what I heard from the regulator's office, second hand. They stated that our disclosure last year was complete, which is good news. But they also indicated that the new rules would come into force in January, and they emphasized that the rationale for every price change has to be recorded in one system. They did not say that we are doing anything wrong. They said that the standard is going to be higher.
